title: Corpus-wide PSTH correlation scan matching FEF Unit 51 reference profile
notes: Scanned 8,597 units across 21 sessions against FEF Unit 51 (sub-C31o_ses-230823, row 51).
Computed smoothed 4-condition PSTH vectors (-500 to 4124 ms) and Pearson correlation r.
Top match: FEF Unit 52 in same session (r = 0.887, p < 1e-300).
Top inter-area match: TEO Unit 357 (r = 0.824) and PFC Unit 43 (r = 0.797).
Rendered 300 DPI PNG raster suites into outputs/raster_suites/fef51_similar/.
